races.paceDynamic: Invincible Boy stands out as the main pace-setter with his prominent style and proven early speed, likely to be joined by King's Road Dandy and Showtown in the early positions. With several hold-up horses including Spaceman, Go Teejay, Eva The Deeva and Rousham, plus five complete unknowns on debut, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic. Invincible Boy can dictate terms from the front without serious pressure, allowing him to kick clear in the straight while the hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground on the soft going. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace, as the lack of genuine speed pressure will make it difficult for back-markers to close the gap.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Invincible Boy Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Invincible Boy gets an uncontested lead and the debutants fail to fire.
scenarios.body: He can dictate a moderate pace and have too much in hand when the challengers mount their effort. The soft ground will make it harder for hold-up horses to produce their usual finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred newcomers shows immediate ability and gets involved early.
scenarios.body: Star With Purpose or Davenport Lass could have enough natural ability to overcome their inexperience, especially with the Easterby string looking for their first winner. A newcomer with pace will benefit from the likely steady early gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Spaceman Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Spaceman gets the perfect hold-up trip.
scenarios.body: His previous promise at Redcar suggests he has the ability, and Oisin Orr is a strong booking from the in-form Fahey yard. However, the soft ground and likely steady pace make this difficult to achieve.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses engage early and create a stronger gallop than expected.
scenarios.body: King's Road Dandy and Showtown could press Invincible Boy harder than anticipated, setting it up for a closer finish. This would give the better hold-up horses like Spaceman more chance, but the field lacks depth for a true collapse.

watchPoints.text: Invincible Boy could get too easy a lead if the debutants are slow away and King's Road Dandy needs the run
Watch the market for Davenport Lass as the Easterby yard will know what they have with this well-bred newcomer
Spaceman needs a strong pace to be effective but may struggle if Invincible Boy gets uncontested fractions
King's Road Dandy is returning from gelding and long break so may need this run to show his true ability
Star With Purpose has the breeding to be sharp on debut but trainer form is poor recently

races.paceDynamic: Arabian Desert holds the key as the likely pace-setter with his prominent style and class edge, facing minimal early pressure from fellow prominent runners Haayimm and Seattle Chief. The pace will be genuine but sustainable over this mile trip on testing ground, with hold-up horses August Spring, Contemplation and Pop The Question relying on others to collapse. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent/tracking horses who can position close to Arabian Desert and have the class to kick when it matters, rather than pure front-runners or deep closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Class Tells Prominently
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady
scenarios.body: Arabian Desert's superior form and RPR 100 rating will prove decisive as he controls from the front, with the hold-up horses too far back on this testing ground. His Horris Hill second gives him a significant class edge that the opposition cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Clough shows significant ability on debut with strong market support
scenarios.body: The gelding/wind operations suggest connections have been patient, and as a Mastercraftsman colt he could have natural ability that trumps exposed moderate form. His fresh legs and unknown potential create the upset.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Arabian Desert, Haayimm and Seattle Chief go too fast early, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. The testing ground aids the late charge from those who conserve energy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Turf Switch Works
scenarios.trigger: If the AW-to-turf switchers find significant improvement on grass
scenarios.body: Seattle Chief and Regulus Black both show marked improvement moving from artificial surfaces to natural turf, with their breeding suggesting they should handle the softer conditions better. Their recent runs underestimate their true ability.

watchPoints.text: Arabian Desert's fitness after 164-day break - any market drift would be concerning given his class advantage
Clough's market moves as the sole newcomer - strong support would suggest hidden ability after patient handling
Early pace development between Arabian Desert, Haayimm and Seattle Chief - if too fierce it opens the door for closers
Ground conditions if deteriorating further - already testing and any worsening could favour the hold-up horses more
Regulus Black and Seattle Chief for signs of turf improvement - their AW form may significantly understate grass ability

races.paceDynamic: Uppercase is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested from the start. With Kokanee, Poet's Dawn and Not Me likely to settle prominently behind him, the pace should be genuine but sustainable rather than cut-throat. The moderate early gallop will allow hold-up horses like Alpha Capture, Urban Road, Typical Woman and Zowal to get into contention turning for home. This tactical scenario strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can capitalize on the lack of early pace pressure and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Uppercase sets an uncontested lead allowing closers to strike
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace plays directly into the hands of the backmarkers who get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Alpha Capture and Urban Road can time their runs to perfection while the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challengers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Kokanee or Poet's Dawn apply enough pressure to soften up Uppercase
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the best of both worlds - close enough to strike but not doing the donkey work. Kokanee's class and Poet's Dawn's experience tell in a moderate finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Uppercase gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to conserve energy and prove too strong when the closers make their bids. Travis Ford's 7lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and it becomes a sprint from 3f out
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with horses coming from all parts of the field. Any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position.

Uppercase gets uncontested lead but Travis Ford's 7lb claim helps offset 259-day absence

races.paceDynamic: Pink Azalea will lead from the start with no obvious challenger for the front, setting her own pace through moderate fractions on the soft ground. Swift Salian may track her closely in second, but the majority of this field consists of hold-up horses who will settle well back early. The lack of early pace pressure means Pink Azalea can dictate terms before the hold-up brigade launch their challenges from the back in the final three furlongs. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows her to control the race completely, with hold-up horses left with too much to do when she accelerates. Swift Salian tracking in second gives him the best chance to respond if the leader falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses get shuffled back and struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: Multiple horses converge at once in the straight creating a wall of traffic, allowing those with cleaner runs to capitalize. The best-weighted and most in-form closers will navigate through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea's stamina gives out in the final furlong after dictating
scenarios.body: Swift Salian inherits the lead but gets swamped by the late charge of fresher hold-up horses who benefit from the slow early gallop. The strongest finishers pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Swift Salian or another horse decides to challenge Pink Azalea early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates a more honest gallop that plays to stamina rather than sprint speed. Hold-up horses get a better target to aim at.

watchPoints.text: Pink Azalea's jumping and early fractions - if she breaks slowly or gets pressured early, the race dynamics completely change
Swift Salian's fitness after 201-day layoff - any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries could eliminate the main pace threat
Latin's turf readaptation after five AW wins since December - market support will indicate connections' confidence in surface switch
Traffic developing behind the leaders turning for home - with seven hold-up horses, positioning will be crucial
Mount King and Distinction both returning from long breaks - any market moves suggest yard confidence despite trainer records

runners_data.comment: Gained 5f AW wins the last twice; dual Group scorer on turf as a 2yo; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Had a long spell in Hong Kong; gradually back in business since returning to Britain and gained 5f AW wins the last twice; still attractively treated, considering he was a dual Group scorer on turf as a 2yo.

runners_data.name: Wobwobwob
runners_data.note: Too old at 8 and prefers longer trips, 164 days off makes task even harder
runners_data.comment: One of the oldest contenders and could well be tapped for toe dropped to 5f
runners_data.spotlight: One of the oldest contenders in this field and has done his winning over 6f/7f, mostly on ground softer than good; could well be tapped for toe in this belated first attempt at the minimum trip.

runners_data.name: Arklow Lad
runners_data.note: Low-mileage 4-year-old with prominent style, new connections firing and good AW form
runners_data.comment: Couple of good performances on AW for shrewd new connections; open to further progress
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who was a turf scorer in Ireland; couple of good performances on AW for shrewd new connections, justifying favouritism at Chelmsford (5f) then third at Wolverhampton (6f; winner franked the form on Good Friday); remains open to further progress, provided he takes to added cheekpieces; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Havana Rum
runners_data.note: Hold-up style wrong for race shape and 5-pound claimer Ethan Tindall inexperienced
runners_data.comment: Far less exposed over 5f than 6f but he's rather in the deep end at this level
runners_data.spotlight: Successful on AW in most recent 5f attempt and is far less exposed at this trip than 6f; however, he's rather in the deep end at this level returned to turf; yet to win above Class 4.

runners_data.name: Reigning Profit
runners_data.note: Prominent but 5-pound claimer disadvantage and traffic problems shown previously
runners_data.comment: Record of 4-6 over C&D features two wins in the month of April; clear possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten only 2l, despite traffic issues, in both AW runs this year; record of 4-6 over C&D features two wins in the month of April; 4lb out of the weights back up in grade but Tom Kiely-Marshall takes off a handy 5lb; clear possibilities back here.

races.paceDynamic: Spartan Arrow will take the field along from the front with Purosangue, Seven Questions, Vantheman, Dark Cloud Rising and Lethal Nymph all positioned prominently behind. This creates a strong pace with multiple early leaders ensuring no soft sectionals over this minimum trip. The hold-up horses Kylian, Elegant Erin, Atomic Force and Havana Rum will be caught wide or too far back to mount effective challenges. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can track the pace and strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Spartan Arrow sets honest pace without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get perfect tow and one strikes late when leader tires. Purosangue or Dark Cloud Rising benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Spartan Arrow gets easy lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Leader gets soft fractions then quickens away from field in final two furlongs. Hold-up horses left with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fast Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early pace becomes too strong with multiple leaders
scenarios.body: Front runners come back to field badly in final furlong allowing closers to pick up pieces. Elegant Erin and Atomic Force benefit from late charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If pace becomes stop-start affair with tactical riding
scenarios.body: Race becomes messy sprint finish where any horse with turn of foot can win. Lower-rated horses get chance to outfinish favorites.

watchPoints.text: Spartan Arrow may get uncontested lead if prominent horses sit too far back early
Purosangue returning after 185-day break but Robert Cowell runners often go well fresh
Dark Cloud Rising sole Pontefract attempt resulted in poor effort, course may not suit
Multiple prominent horses could create early battle that sets up race for hold-up horses
Elegant Erin veteran status at 9 years old but two recent course wins cannot be ignored

races.name: Tommy Hepple Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Johnny Boom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won on soft ground at Leicester but too inconsistent to trust after poor recent AW form
runners_data.comment: Surprise winner on soft ground in October but too inconsistent to rely upon
runners_data.spotlight: Caused 28-1 surprise on soft ground at Leiester (1m4f) in the autumn but was below that form on his two AW starts in February (wore cheekpieces) and is too inconsistent to rely upon; no headgear today.

runners_data.name: Swinging London
runners_data.note: Confirmed stayer who needs the trip but carries a tough 133lbs after respectable Southwell fourth
runners_data.comment: Ran okay on AW when back on the Flat last month but turf Flat strike-rate is 0-14
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to the Flat with respectable fourth of six at Southwell (1m4f, AW) last month but is still 3lb higher than for narrow AW win last autumn, and his Flat turf strike-rate is 0-14.

runners_data.name: Turn And Finish
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from disappointing hurdles campaign, needs to prove he retains Flat ability
runners_data.comment: Became disappointing over hurdles last year; down the field on AW for new yard last month
runners_data.spotlight: Became rather disappointing over hurdles for Harry Derham last year and finished down the field when returning in 1m4f AW handicap for new stable last month; needs that recent outing to have brought him on.

runners_data.name: Starshine Legend
runners_data.note: Strong closer for Olly Murphy returning after 580 days, first-time for powerful yard could spark improvement
runners_data.comment: Makes stable debut after a long absence; market helpful
runners_data.spotlight: Scored in first-time cheekpieces on handicap debut for James Ferguson in June 2024 and signed off for him with good effort in first-time blinkers the following September; makes stable debut after 580-day absence and with no headgear but is versatile regarding ground; market helpful.

runners_data.name: Fleur De Mer
runners_data.note: Consistent stayer in first-time cheekpieces, strong recent AW placings suggest she's in good heart
runners_data.comment: Placed over 1m6f on last three AW starts; back in trip with cheekpieces added here
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over 1m6f on last three AW starts; returns to turf on a workable mark and should be fine back at 1m4f; big player if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

runners_data.name: Ashdown Forest
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse absent 166 days from Flat racing, hurdles form unconvincing for Jedd O'Keeffe
runners_data.comment: Returns to the Flat after some uninspiring hurdle form; sports new cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Not seen on the Flat since well-held third on heavy ground for Ed Walker last autumn and subsequent hurdling form for Jedd O'Keeffe was not particularly inspiring; sports first-time cheekpieces; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Lightening Company
runners_data.note: Deep closer now 5lb lower than when second here last October, but failed to fire in three subsequent runs
runners_data.comment: Second over C&D last October but well down the field all three subsequent AW starts
runners_data.spotlight: Now 5lb lower than when second here (1m2f, soft) last October but did not emerge from the rear division when a big-priced outsider for all three subsequent AW runs; considered only if much strong in betting today.

runners_data.name: Princess Niyla
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 215 days but won off today's mark previously and goes well fresh
runners_data.comment: Absent since below-par run in September but ran well when fresh last season; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since below-par AW run (without usual cheekpieces) last September but ran well when fresh last season and subsequently won off today's mark over 1m2f; also suited by 1m4f; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Suitcase Smith
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent type who raced too freely on handicap debut, needs to settle better
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on handicap debut last October and not seen since
runners_data.spotlight: Still unexposed after only four starts but was soundly beaten after racing too freely on handicap debut at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to soft) in October and this is his first run since.

runners_data.name: Cloudy Rose
runners_data.note: Proven stayer who won off this mark last season but 188 days since last run raises fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Won twice last season but ended that campaign on a low note
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last season, the latest off today's mark at Doncaster (extended 1m6f, good); also suited by 1m4f but ended that campaign on a low note and her fitness must be taken on trust.

runners_data.name: Very Muddy Waters
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing maiden in first-time blinkers, showed promise but needs to break duck
runners_data.comment: Eight-race maiden; ran okay on AW when last in action, but that was five months ago
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; didn't run badly when sixth at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last November but has fitness to prove after five-month break and was well beaten over C&D on only previous 1m4f attempt.

runners_data.name: Treasure Islands
runners_data.note: Unexposed four-year-old making handicap debut for Tim Easterby after pleasing Southwell fourth
runners_data.comment: Made pleasing seasonal debut in AW novice; can improve again in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo who made quite pleasing seasonal debut when keeping-on fourth in Southwell novice (1m3f, AW) last month; up in trip for this handicap debut, and should have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Secret Alliance
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader making turf debut after disappointing AW form, needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in three AW maiden/novice races (1m3f-1m4f) last summer/autumn
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in three AW maiden/novice races (1m3f-1m4f) last summer/autumn and needs to take a big step forward on this seasonal/turf/handicap debut

races.paceDynamic: Secret Alliance will take them along as the only confirmed front-runner, with Princess Niyla and Very Muddy Waters likely to sit just behind in prominent positions early. The lack of pace pressure should allow Secret Alliance to dictate a steady tempo through the first mile before the race develops from the 3f pole. With most of this field preferring to come from off the pace, the relatively uncontested lead will create a tactical advantage for those who can position themselves handy and travel well into the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with a turn of foot over pure front-runners or deep closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Alliance gets an easy lead and stays the extended trip
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front-runner to conserve energy and prove hard to peg back in the closing stages. Several hold-up horses may not get the strong pace they need to showcase their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and Princess Niyla or Very Muddy Waters can position perfectly
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk the leader without pressure then strike with a sustained challenge from the 2f pole. Their forward position gives them first run on the field when the race begins in earnest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and allows a closer to produce a decisive late surge
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a bunched field entering the straight, allowing a hold-up horse with genuine class to sweep through. Fleur De Mer or Cloudy Rose could benefit from the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Alliance stops suddenly and creates a muddling affair
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with no clear pace narrative, potentially suiting an unexposed type like Treasure Islands who can quicken from any position. Form lines become less relevant in a messy tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Secret Alliance must prove 174 days off the track hasn't dulled his speed - if he breaks slowly the entire pace scenario changes
Princess Niyla returning without her usual cheekpieces after 215 days could struggle if not cherry-ripe for Alan Brown
Starshine Legend making stable debut for Olly Murphy after 580-day absence - any market support would be highly significant
Turn And Finish needs to prove his class transfer back from hurdles after well-held effort at Southwell last month
Fleur De Mer wearing cheekpieces for the first time - any positive effect could unlock improvement from consistent stayer

races.name: OAP Free Day Tuesday 21st April Handicap

runners_data.name: Miss Magic Dragon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on debut handicap after 102 days off, massive price drop needed from recent all-weather form
runners_data.comment: Modest form in three AW runs in late 2025; could prove different proposition now h'capping
runners_data.spotlight: Huge prices and low-level form in three AW runs in late 2025; bred to do much better at some point and she needs a close market check from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Mystical Land
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent Newcastle second, key player if not too keen early like previous runs
runners_data.comment: 2nd (5f, AW) off this mark in January; less good twice since but there have been excuses
runners_data.spotlight: Second to an unexposed rival at Newcastle in January (5f) off this mark; not so good in either run since but he was too free on the first occasion and then unsuited by a messy event last time; unraced on turf slower than good; still has a bigger run in him.

runners_data.name: Maynora
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who was too keen last time in slow-run race, needs to settle better to show his ability
runners_data.comment: Seemingly exposed but bits of form that bring him into the picture; no headgear today
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; bits of form that offer hope and his latest effort, when too keen in a steadily run 7f event at Newcastle, isn't the run to judge him on; seemingly exposed but goes without headgear today and the stable won this race in 2024.

runners_data.name: Baldosa
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning sharper after recent third, first try at this trip could be tactical issue
runners_data.comment: Satisfactory third on seasonal return (6f, AW); unraced on slower than good on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Ran as well as she ever has when third of seven at Newcastle 17 days ago, her first run for 172 days; should be sharper with that behind her but this will be the slowest turf she will have encountered.

runners_data.name: Proud Mary
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 213 days off, likely needs this run back on turf
runners_data.comment: Didn't achieve a great deal as a 2yo but should find her level in minor handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in three quick runs on turf last summer (5f-6f; good or faster ground); likely to do better at some point this year.

runners_data.name: The Tunguska Event
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course winner form, better drawn than previous rival Dream Forever today
runners_data.comment: Won 2 of his 5 AW h'cap runs; up 5lb for latest but could have more to come back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two of his five handicap runs, more recently when beating Dream Forever at Newcastle eight weeks ago; better drawn than his old rival today and may confirm the placings despite 5lb worse terms.

runners_data.name: Miss Boyd
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fading tendency, returning to turf after 7lb drop but runs too soon after last effort
runners_data.comment: Some promise on turf last summer; quiet on AW since; may do better back on the grass
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise on turf last August; struggled on AW since, including both handicap runs, but she has dropped 7lb and returns to turf at a realistic level; too soon to write her off.

runners_data.name: Trucial Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with consistent handicap placings, previous turf form came on much faster ground
runners_data.comment: Leaves the impression a bigger run is lurking but she has a wide stall to overcome
runners_data.spotlight: Currently 0-8 but she has shown more than enough in AW handicaps this year to think races could fall her way; both turf runs on good to firm (encouragement for slower on breeding); wide draw to overcome.

runners_data.name: Liquid Cooled
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in great form after recent Newcastle win, faces stronger field on different surface
runners_data.comment: Big step forward when winning on handicap debut last month (6f, AW); contender up 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Left the form of his first three runs well behind when powering home to win a 6f handicap at Newcastle four weeks ago; this is a deeper race on a different surface, and off a 5lb higher mark, but it would be no surprise to see another big run.

runners_data.name: Telling Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with fading tendency, faces difficult task from wide draw after best recent effort
runners_data.comment: Latest AW 2nd represented improvement; wide stall to overcome back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ran his best race so far when second of ten at Wolverhampton three weeks ago (6f); more on his plate in this field and he has a wide stall to contend with.

runners_data.name: Full Gas
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after gelding operation, hasn't been seen for 66 days since last run
runners_data.comment: December's Newcastle fourth was promising; ran poorly on handicap debut; unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded prior to his improved showing in a 7f novice at Newcastle in December; well beaten in a 6f handicap back at Newcastle in January but he still has time on his side and now drops into a 0-60.

runners_data.name: Dream Forever
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse meeting The Tunguska Event on improved terms, consistent recent efforts over this trip
runners_data.comment: Two solid efforts on AW this year; can win races but perhaps not this one from stall 14
runners_data.spotlight: Chased home The Tunguska Event at Newcastle (6f) in February and meets that rival on 5lb better terms for 1.25l; didn't run badly over 7f back at Newcastle last month when not ideally positioned; can win races off this mark but he will have to overcome stall 14 if this is to be one of them.

runners_data.name: Antique Blue
runners_data.note: Natural leader with fading tendency, needs experience after two heavy defeats for new trainer
runners_data.comment: Hooded for handicap debut; bred to be useful but he is not a solid option
runners_data.spotlight: In need of the experience in one run for Andrew Balding last June (6f, AW; wore cheekpieces); two heavy defeats for Ruth Carr, the latest at Newcastle (7f) 19 days ago; hooded for his handicap debut; bred to be useful but he is not a solid option.

runners_data.name: Battenburg Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden stepping into handicaps after 77 days off, needs market support to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Modest form on AW this winter; more realistic task now handicapping; market useful
runners_data.spotlight: No better than midfield in three maiden/novice runs on AW; more realistic task today; the betting should provide clues.

races.paceDynamic: Antique Blue is the sole confirmed front runner in this 14-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure. The prominent runners Mystical Land, Maynora, The Tunguska Event, and Full Gas will track behind but none are natural pace forcers. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses including Liquid Cooled, Dream Forever, Baldosa, and Trucial Pearl, the pace will be measured early before quickening from the 2f marker. This race shape strongly favors front runners and prominent racers who can utilize the early positional advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Antique Blue gets an easy lead and stays on strongly in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the front runner to dictate fractions and kick clear when challenged. Despite recent poor form, the tactical advantage outweighs class concerns in this moderate handicap.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get perfect stalking positions behind the uncontested leader
scenarios.body: Mystical Land or The Tunguska Event can track the pace and pounce in the final furlong when Antique Blue weakens. Their superior recent form tells over the pace-setting leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: Liquid Cooled can repeat his recent Newcastle success with a powerful late surge through traffic. The condensed field plays into the hands of horses with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Antique Blue stops suddenly and the prominent horses fail to capitalize effectively
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any horse getting a clear run can prevail. Form and ratings become less relevant in the resulting lottery finish.

watchPoints.text: Antique Blue must be watched for early pace judgment - if William Pyle pushes too hard early, the leader will stop suddenly
Mystical Land needs monitoring for settling - if Connor Beasley can't get him to relax, he'll weaken badly in the final furlong
The market moves on Miss Magic Dragon and Battenburg Belle will reveal stable confidence in their handicap debuts
Track the pace through the first half-mile - if it's genuinely crawling, hold-up horses like Liquid Cooled become much more dangerous
Dream Forever's finishing position relative to The Tunguska Event will confirm whether the weight swing is significant enough to reverse their previous meeting

races.name: Sue Sheppard Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Ganesha
runners_data.note: Prominent runner drawn wide in stall 12 facing traffic problems with 5 others wanting same position
runners_data.comment: Well short of best on last three starts; drops in class but has the widest stall to defy
runners_data.spotlight: Well short of his best on his last three starts; now returns to Class 6 company off a reduced mark but he has been done no favours by the draw.

runners_data.name: Harb
runners_data.note: Hold-up sprinter who won at Newcastle off lower mark, needs room to deploy finishing kick
runners_data.comment: Not at best over 6f last time; earlier 5f efforts bring him right into the reckoning
runners_data.spotlight: Successful at Newcastle in February (5f) off 2lb lower; solid effort next time and when down the field on his latest start it was over 6f; can't rule out back down in trip.

runners_data.name: Kitaab
runners_data.note: Patient closer for in-form Philip Kirby stable, well handicapped on 2024 form
runners_data.comment: Handicapped to win and while perhaps best at 6f, he can't be discounted; will need luck

runners_data.name: Wrestling Revenue
runners_data.note: Won course and distance in October, hold-up style suits if he can find gaps late
runners_data.comment: Third in this race last year and then won over C&D in October; good draw; could revive
runners_data.spotlight: Finished third in the corresponding race last year (good ground) and won a C&D handicap in October off a 4lb lower mark; disappointed twice since but he has landed a good draw back at Pontefract and a revival would be no surprise.

runners_data.name: Monotone
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to 5f with tongue-tie back on after 67-day break
runners_data.comment: Drops in trip and class with a tongue tie back on; a revival isn't out of the question
runners_data.spotlight: Thrown in on his form for Jim Bolger but he has finished down the field in four runs for new connections, weakening over 7f and 6f; the return of a tongue tie may help, as will the drop into a Class 6, so not discounted back at 5f for the owners who took this race 12 months ago.

runners_data.name: Sergeant Mayer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 168-day absence off just 1lb higher than last win
runners_data.comment: In good form last spring; feasible mark now back from 168 days off; usual headgear absent
runners_data.spotlight: Came to hand early last year and he returns from a 168-day break off a mark just 1lb higher than for his Ripon win 11 months ago; the absence of cheekpieces tempers enthusiasm this time.

runners_data.name: Mu Mu Land
runners_data.note: Patient type dropping to 5f after wind operation, 124 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Dropped 13lb in a blank 3yo campaign; had wind op since latest; drops to 5f; tricky draw
runners_data.spotlight: 6f AW maiden winner as a 2yo; 0-7 in handicaps last year but he dropped 13lb in the weights as a result; had a wind op soon after latest run in December; drops to 5f for the first time since his debut; wide draw.

runners_data.name: Get Up Everybody
runners_data.note: Prominent runner back from wind operation after showing improvement last season
runners_data.comment: 0-9 but placed in 3 of his last 4 starts in 2025; had wind op since latest; market useful
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden but clear signs he was getting the hang of racing last year, placed in three of his last four starts; he has had a wind operation since last seen; market useful back from a six-month absence.

runners_data.name: Canaria Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare off 161-day break but was in excellent form before the layoff
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 in good form; fair mark if ready to roll after her 161-day absence
runners_data.spotlight: In good form in the second half of 2025, winning three times over 5f; not on a bad mark for her return but she has a 161-day absence to defy.

runners_data.name: Iris Dancer
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner drawn in stall 1, returning from 162-day break
runners_data.comment: Prolific winner; on a handy mark but first time out hasn't been the time to catch her
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific winner, mainly at Hamilton, and she starts this campaign off a manageable mark and from the inside stall; first time out hasn't been the time to catch her and her apprentice is having her first ride under rules.

runners_data.name: Masterclass
runners_data.note: Hold-up sprinter on same mark as Nottingham win, blinders back on after 138 days

runners_data.name: Jojo Rabbit

runners_data.spotlight: Twice made all at Beverley last summer (5f, good and good to firm); shaped as though the run was needed on his return at Wolverhampton 18 days ago; on a handy mark; considered.

runners_data.name: Lucius Aurelius
runners_data.note: Prominent maiden trapped behind horses at Southwell, needs cleaner passage
runners_data.comment: Exposed maiden but on a dangerous mark and latest run is easy to forgive; tricky draw
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed maiden but has plenty of ability for one of his rating; unable to show what he could do at Southwell four weeks ago when trapped behind a wall of horses from 2f out; double-figure draw to contend with today but he should be winning soon.

runners_data.name: Pinjarra
runners_data.note: Prominent runner successful over 6f on AW, faces wide draw and drop back to 5f
runners_data.comment: Prominent racer; three 6f AW wins since August; drops back to 5f from a wide stall
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent racer who has won three 6f events on AW since August; not at his best at Southwell last month and he has a wide stall to overcome returned to 5f.

races.paceDynamic: Iris Dancer will lead from the rail with no genuine pace pressure, allowing her to dictate fractions over this sharp 5f trip. The prominent brigade of Ganesha, Monotone, Jojo Rabbit, Get Up Everybody, Lucius Aurelius and Pinjarra will create significant congestion behind her, with 6 runners wanting the same tactical position. This creates a traffic nightmare approaching the final 2f as the hold-up horses like Harb, Kitaab, Wrestling Revenue and Sergeant Mayer need room to unleash their finishing kicks. The controlled early pace and inevitable squeeze in the prominent pack strongly favours front-running tactics and patient hold-up horses who can find gaps late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer gets an uncontested lead from stall 1
scenarios.body: She controls the tempo completely and kicks clear while the prominent pack gets tangled up behind her. The lack of early pressure allows her to save energy for a sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a wall of horses 2f out
scenarios.body: The patient closers benefit from the moderate early pace and find cleaner passages while the prominent runners are trapped. Sergeant Mayer and Wrestling Revenue can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures an ideal position behind Iris Dancer
scenarios.body: Jojo Rabbit or Get Up Everybody track the leader without getting caught in traffic and strike when she weakens. The tactical advantage of avoiding the squeeze pays dividends.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer stops quickly after setting steady fractions
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up in the final furlong creating a cavalry charge finish. Any horse with a clear run and finishing kick can capitalize on the messy conclusion.

watchPoints.text: Massive pile-up brewing 2f out as Ganesha, Monotone, Jojo Rabbit, Get Up Everybody, Lucius Aurelius and Pinjarra all want prominent positions
Iris Dancer's 162-day layoff could see her stop quickly if the sustained pace tells late
Sergeant Mayer and Wrestling Revenue both returning from long breaks but hold ideal hold-up styles for this pace shape
Stall 12 draw severely handicaps Ganesha who needs to cross over early to secure position
Kevin Stott on Lucius Aurelius seeking redemption after being trapped at Southwell last month
